situation: Implemented an approved Android bilingual voice-routing phase across recognition, prompting and streaming TTS.
solution: Preserved domain-safe recognition metadata to the generation boundary and resolved one immutable language decision per turn through a pure state coordinator.
lesson: When several pipeline stages need the same inferred state, preserve source metadata and pass one tested domain decision through every stage instead of re-inferring locally.
privacy: No audio or user transcript content was stored.
